blocks.text: Michelle Marquez Dee is officially out of MGI All Stars 2nd Edition, the organizers confirmed on social media ahead of an official statement from the actress-model-singer. In releasing the early tally of the online voting for “All Stars Exclusive Dinner,” MGI All Stars announced that Dee and Alexie Brooks, another contender from the Philippines, are among the five leading ladies in the social media component of the poll. “Although Michelle Dee from the Philippines has withdrawn, we would still like to honor her place in this voting activity until it concludes,” the caption read. “This allows Filipino supporters to continue showing […]...
